title: Understanding Model Risk
text: The model risk is the sum of the model bias squared, model variance, and observational variance.

title: Formula for Observational Variance
text: Observational variance can be calculated using the formula: \( \text{Model Risk} $$=$$ \text{Bias}**2 + \text{Variance} + \text{Observational Variance} \).
